text:
</sub>  Define codes for rejected compared findings

When a sweep-enabled or control review produces a false positive or out-of-scope finding, the cohort can close only after that finding receives a terminal rejection/out-of-scope outcome, but the dependency comparison enum contains only `ronda_miss`, `ronda_better`, `duplicate`, `clean_agreement`, and `unclear`, while this spec adds only `ronda_only` and explicitly withholds codes for the rejection cases. `ronda_better` cannot cover a noisy Ronda-only finding because its existing meaning is that Ronda avoided another reviewer's noise. Define recordable code values and transitions for these terminal outcomes; otherwise implementations must invent incompatible values or leave such pull requests permanently unadjudicated.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L45-L45](https://github.com/lhpaul/ronda/blob/f0062e71726740685df6c5127d6ec7a0f4675d00/AGENTS.md#L45-L45)
rationale: Author fixed it: Fixed in ca42088. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
